verdict.rationale: Martin documents a 'background tasks' category in which it works on its own: proactively drafting emails, triaging email with follow-up actions, scheduling meetings when cc'd, and sending briefings. It also offers custom shortcuts that trigger multi-step actions. These are specific, predefined task types rather than general open-ended delegation, and no review handoff or checkpoint before results are delivered is documented. Missing for 10: arbitrary multi-step task delegation, documented review/approval step for returned work, task status/progress tracking, independent hands-on corroboration of background execution.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: Cc Martin on an email to schedule a meeting.
